title: Triangles minimize the Monge-Ampère eigenvalue among planar bounded convex domains of a given area
summary: We prove that triangles minimize the Monge-Ampère eigenvalue among bounded planar convex domains of a given area, thus resolving the two-dimensional case of Le's simplex conjecture for the Monge-Ampère eigenvalue (The eigenvalue problem for the Monge-Ampère operator on general bounded convex domains, Ann. Sc. Norm. Super. Pisa Cl. Sci. (5) 18 (2018)). The proof uses a neighbor-decreasing property of the Monge-Ampère eigenvalues of convex polygons along vertex elimination parallel chord movements.
